It is observable and verifiable — the agent must navigate to and look at a melon. Since we are selecting exactly 1 task, there are no dependencies to chain, but this task is ideal because: (1) it doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, (2) it is clearly verifiable by checking if a melon block is within the agent's view or proximity, (3) the scene can be designed to make it a meaningful navigation challenge by placing the melon at a specific location that requires exploration. A melon is visually distinctive (green striped block) making it easy to confirm task completion.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the melon block and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. The melon is placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 5] inside a 3-sided fenced farm area (open on the west side). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance (the sandbox agent could clearly see the melon from ~8 blocks away at step 10), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the melon rather than away from it. position_near_with_facing is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target' rather than just proximity.

To the right and ahead (~6 blocks east, ~5 blocks south) is a fenced farm plot open on the west side containing a melon and pumpkin on farmland. A small oak planks hut with a crafting table is behind the player to the northwest. Hay blocks and a composter add farm atmosphere. The scene is surrounded by natural forest.
task_text: Find the melon block in the nearby farm area.
design_notes: The melon is placed at spawn-relative [6, 0, 5] inside a 3-sided oak fence enclosure (open on west/left side for easy access). Farmland is placed first, then the melon is set on top at the same Y level. The pumpkin at [7, 0, 6] serves as a contextual companion crop. The oak planks hut at [-4 to -2, 0 to 2, -4 to -2] provides a visual landmark. Hay block at [3, 0, -1] and composter at [2, 0, 0] add farm atmosphere. The scene is compact (~20 block radius) and all elements are reachable from spawn.
